headword: {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}

definitions.explanation: The physical and biological surroundings in their unaltered state, including ecosystems, landscapes, waterways, and wildlife habitats. Frequently used in environmental discussions and policy.

examples.japanese: {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We investigate the impact of development on the natural environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な{自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}されて→残す：01975_nokosu⟧おり、⟦{世界遺産|せかいいさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This island has preserved a rich natural environment and is registered as a World Heritage site.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧ (nature) and ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ (environment). A key term in environmental science, policy, and everyday discussion about ecology and conservation. Frequently appears in news about development projects, conservation efforts, and climate change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保全|ほぜん}→保全：11560_hozen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to conserve the natural environment
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧: destruction of the natural environment
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配慮|はいりょ}する→配慮する：26831_hairyosuru⟧: to be considerate of the natural environment
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: environmental survey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: environment — broader; includes social and living environments as well as natural
- ⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧: ecosystem — more technical; refers to the interconnected system of organisms and their environment
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧: nature — the general concept; {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう} is more specific to the surrounding conditions
